style: Single SQUARE 1:1 full-bleed realistic photograph for an ADULT Arabic AAC app communication card. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: match its warm natural photographic realism, approachable adult expressions, sharp detailed skin and eyes, soft warm cream/beige home setting and restrained muted clothing.

assets.name: img_cat_greetings
assets.prompt: Two adult Arab men greeting with a handshake; full-bleed warm realistic cover matched to Family image.

assets.name: greeting_how_are_you
assets.prompt: Two CLEARLY DIFFERENT Arab male friends chatting in a bright cream living room. One is a slim clean-shaven man about 35 with short straight black hair and thin rectangular eyeglasses, wearing a muted gray casual shirt. The other is a stockier dark-brown-skinned man about 65 with short silver hair and a trimmed silver beard, wearing an olive cardigan. They sit on a sofa facing slightly toward each other; the younger man has a kindly questioning expression with a slight head tilt, the elder smiles back. BOTH MEN'S HANDS REST NATURALLY ON THEIR OWN KNEES, with visible continuous arms and sleeves from shoulder through elbow to wrist. NO RAISED HANDS, NO CROSSED ARMS, NO HAND BETWEEN THE BODIES. Upper-body medium two-shot with knees partly in frame; friendly 'how are you' conversation.

assets.name: greeting_hello
assets.prompt: A dark-brown-skinned Arab man about 30, athletic average build, close-cropped black hair, short neat beard, no headwear, wearing a muted teal long-sleeved casual shirt. Facing camera with a friendly natural smile and a simple hello wave beside his shoulder. One raised arm with a fully visible continuous sleeve/forearm and wrist; relaxed elbow; open palm with exactly five anatomically natural fingers. Other arm rests down by his side. Clearly a NEW person, different from the reference people.

assets.name: greeting_reply
assets.prompt: An Arab woman about 65 with a fuller round face, tan skin, naturally lined mature features and a kindly smile, wearing a muted turquoise hijab fully covering hair and neck and a modest cream long-sleeved blouse. She replies respectfully to a greeting with a slight nod and her right hand naturally resting over her upper chest. Her sleeve and forearm visibly connect wrist to bent elbow and body. Other hand relaxed out of view, no extra arm. Clearly older and different-looking from the women in the references.

assets.name: greeting_salam
assets.prompt: A clean-shaven Arab man about 40 with light olive skin, short neatly combed brown hair, a broader round face and no headwear or glasses, wearing a muted brown casual shirt. A respectful gentle greeting: his right hand rests naturally over his upper chest, the entire forearm is visibly attached through the sleeve and bent elbow. Other arm relaxed at side. Warm composed smile, dignified adult, clearly different from all reference people.

assets.name: greeting_welcome
assets.prompt: A mature Arab woman in a soft sage hijab covering hair and neck and a modest beige long-sleeved outfit welcoming a visitor through a warmly lit open home doorway, open palm gesturing inward at mid chest level, smiling toward visitor. Most of picture occupied by her face and upper body.

assets.name: greeting_fine
assets.prompt: A middle-aged Arab woman in a soft ivory hijab covering hair and neck and modest muted green long-sleeved top, giving a calm thankful smile with a natural right hand resting over her heart, shoulders relaxed. Her expression conveys that she is doing well and grateful.

assets.name: greeting_brighten
assets.prompt: A smiling Arab woman around 40 wearing a dusty-rose hijab covering hair and neck and a modest ivory long-sleeved blouse, joyfully welcoming a female friend who appears only as a softly blurred modestly covered shoulder at the far edge. Main woman gestures with an open hand at chest height, warm bright human welcome, no sparkles or literal glowing effects.

assets.name: greeting_good_health
assets.prompt: An adult Arab man in a cream casual shirt warmly thanking an adult male helper in a muted blue shirt after helping carry a small household basket. Main man smiles appreciatively toward helper, with right hand over heart and a slight courteous nod; helper is secondary at far side. Clear friendly appreciation rather than a medical scene.

assets.name: greeting_good_evening
assets.prompt: An Arab man about 60 with short wavy silver hair, a neatly trimmed gray mustache, clean-shaven chin, no headwear and oval eyeglasses, wearing a soft pale-blue casual shirt. Warmly greeting someone with a simple open-palm wave beside his shoulder in a cream living room at dusk. The waving arm, elbow, forearm and wrist connect visibly and naturally, exactly five normal fingers. Warm glowing lamp and a small deep-blue dusk window make the evening context clear while his face stays well lit.

assets.name: greeting_good_morning
assets.prompt: An adult Arab woman wearing a neatly wrapped light beige hijab covering hair and neck and a modest light-blue long-sleeved top greeting someone beside a sunlit home window in the morning, one hand gently raised in a small greeting, other holding a simple white tea cup. Golden morning daylight, bright cream room, human greeting is primary, not a landscape.

assets.name: greeting_goodbye
assets.prompt: An Arab woman about 30 with warm brown skin, a narrower oval face and lively kind eyes, wearing a charcoal-gray hijab fully covering hair and neck and a modest cream long-sleeved coat. She stands at a home doorway, turning slightly as she leaves and looking back with a gentle farewell wave beside her shoulder. The single raised arm connects clearly through shoulder, sleeve, bent elbow, forearm and wrist; five natural fingers. Other arm down naturally. No luggage, no children, a distinct younger adult from the other women.

assets.name: greeting_bless
assets.prompt: A dignified dark-brown-skinned Arab elder about 75, slender face with natural deep smile lines, short white hair and a neat white beard, NO headwear, wearing a warm taupe cardigan over a cream shirt. He makes a quiet dua/blessing gesture with both open palms gently cupped upward at mid chest. Both elbows and forearms clearly attached to his own shoulders and sleeves, symmetrical relaxed natural anatomy, five natural fingers on each hand. Affectionate kind expression looking slightly beside camera.

assets.name: greeting_safe
assets.prompt: A mature Arab mother wearing a beige hijab covering hair and neck and a modest muted green long-sleeved outfit affectionately wishing her ADULT son a safe departure at a home doorway, her right hand resting naturally on his upper shoulder. Both smiling gently, close upper-body composition, son is a grown man aged 30, no children, no hugging that hides faces.

assets.name: greeting_thanks
assets.prompt: An Arab man about 45 with medium-brown skin, bald head, thin dark rectangular eyeglasses, clean-shaven face and a friendly round face, wearing a dusty-blue casual polo shirt. He conveys sincere thanks with ONLY his right hand resting over his chest and a grateful gentle smile. The other arm rests straight at his side; NO outward-reaching or extra hand. Visible continuous sleeve, elbow, forearm and wrist, anatomically correct five fingers.
